profile.headline: Software Engineer | Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Armed with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Wright State University, I am currently driving innovation as a Software Engineer at Amazon, focusing on Prime Video for FireTV. My core competencies lie in developing for Android using Kotlin and Java, which have been critical in delivering features that enhance customer feedback and reliability.

At Amazon, our team has modernized the build approach for feature development, significantly reducing production risks and accelerating development timelines. We prioritize performance and customer satisfaction, showcasing our commitment to excellence and our ability to adapt to the dynamic tech landscape. My experience in cloud-based solutions and UI design at JPMorgan Chase & Co. informs my approach to scalable systems and user-friendly interfaces, allowing us to meet our organizational goals and deliver exceptional value to our users.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Prime Video on FireTV

• Modernized code base by designing and implementing a modular code architecture to help improve development efficiency and scalability while keeping the production environment stable by isolating development changes
• Designed and executed memory usage monitoring process for production, alongside tracking FPS and startup time during the development phase to improve reliability
• Improved customer experience and introduced new functionalities including the implementation of an In-App Survey feature

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Updated and improved reporting service for client summaries based on managed trades by asset managers
•	Migrated service to Sprint Boot and deployed to Gaia cloud
•	Created React internal tool allowing easy configuration of client reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created web interface for data visualization and monitoring in JavaScript, Cesium, Vue, and Spring Boot
•	Deployed application using Gitlab and Docker for automated CI/CD 
•	Managed extensive datasets while ensuring an intuitive user interface

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: •	Updated the backing models of a flight simulator to use a standardized model through Protobufs to allow easy communication between different applications through RabbitMQ that used the same models

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Updated a 32-bit C++ application to use updated STL features and compile in a 64-bit environment
